title: Understanding Fieldtypes
excerpt: Explore the various fieldtypes available in HaruCMS and how to use them effectively.
content:
HaruCMS offers a variety of fieldtypes to handle different types of content:

  • Text - Simple text input
  • Rich Text - WYSIWYG editor
  • Media - Image and file uploads
  • Tags - Tag management
  • Relations - Link between entries

Each fieldtype is designed to make content management as intuitive as possible.
